Rashi on Shabbat 21a:10:2.hebrew: היו מפקיעין - קורעין ועושין פתילות בשמחת בית השואבה, שהיא בעזרת נשים:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:10:2.english: They would unravel - They would tear [them] and make wicks for the Celebration of the Water Drawing, which was in the Women's Courtyard.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:10:4.hebrew: שמחת בית השואבה שאני - דלא כתיב להעלות בה, ולאו דאורייתא היא:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:10:4.english: The Celebration of the Water Drawing is different - For "to cause [a flame] to ascend" is not written regarding it, and it is not of Biblical origin.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:11:1.english: Is it not [referring to garments] of diverse kinds - Such as the sash.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:12:1.english: [If] it went out - [Meaning,] the Hanukkah light.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:12:2.hebrew: זקוק לה - לתקנה. הלכך, צריך לכתחלה לעשות יפה, דילמא פשע ולא מתקן לה:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:12:2.english: [One is] bound to it - To fix it. Therefore, one must prepare [it] well from the outset, lest he be negligent and not fix it.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:12:3.hebrew: ומותר להשתמש לאורה - הלכך, בשבת אסור, שמא יטה לצורך תשמיש:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:12:3.english: And it is permitted to use its light - Therefore, on Shabbat it is forbidden [to light with them], lest he tilt [the lamp] for the purpose of [his] use.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:1:1.hebrew: למקח וממכר - למאן דמתני למזבן שעוה, ליתיב ליה פסולתא דדובשא:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:1:1.english: For buying and selling - To one who stipulates to buy wax, [the seller] should give him the residue of honey.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:2:1.english: However, one may make a bonfire from them - A large fire, in which one [piece] ignites another.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:2:2.english: For a lamp - [In Old French,] croisel [an oil lamp].

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:3:1.hebrew: בשמן קיק - שמן של עוף אחד, נותנין בנר ודולק:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:3:1.english: With kik oil - [It is] oil of a certain bird; one puts [it] into a lamp and it burns.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:3:2.hebrew: משחא דקאזא - שמן שעושין מגרעיני צמר גפן, שקורין קוטו"ן:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:3:2.english: Cotton oil - Oil that is made from the seeds of cotton, which is called coton.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:3:4.english: I have seen for myself - [That is,] the species of Jonah's kikayon [castor plant].

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:3:5.english: And it grows in marshes - It grows in water marshes.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:3:6.english: And at the entrance of the shops they train it - At the entrance of the shops they train it [to climb], for shade and for a pleasant scent.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:3:7.english: From its seeds - From its kernels.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:4:1.hebrew: מסכסכת - כמין סכין פגומה מסכסכת בבשר, אנמילי"ד בלע"ז — שאין אורו זקוף ונוח במקום אחד, אלא נדעך וקופץ. לישנא אחרינא: מסכסכת בהן — אינה נכנסת תוך הפתילה, אלא סביב מבחוץ, כמו סיכסכה אבניו, ברואט"ש בלע"ז:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:4:1.english: Flickers - Like a notched knife that snags in flesh — anmelid in Old French — in that its light is not upright and steady in one place, but rather dies down and jumps. Another explanation: "Flickers on them" — [the flame] does not penetrate into the wick, but rather [burns only] around the outside, as in [the expression] "it grazed its stones" (brouste in Old French).

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:4:2.english: That they are not drawn - And he will come to tilt [the lamp].

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:5:1.english: Any amount of oil - The oil placed into it draws it after the wick.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:5:2.hebrew: לפי שאין מדליקין - בעינייהו, וגזרינן הא אטו הא:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:5:2.english: Because one may not light - [With them] on their own, and we decree this [mixture] on account of that [unmixed oil].

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:6:1.english: One who wrapped a material to make a wick around a material with which one may not light - Such as the invalid wicks of the Mishnah.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:6:2.hebrew: קתני מיהא - בדר"ש מדליקין, ואע"ג דאגוז לא חזי לפתילה, על ידי תערובות שפיר דמי:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:6:2.english: In any case, it teaches - That according to Rabbi Shimon [ben Elazar], one may light; and even though a nut is not fit for a wick, by means of a mixture it is fine.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:7:1.hebrew: מעשה רב - הואיל ומעיד שכך היו של בית אביו עושין, הלכה היא:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:7:1.english: An actual deed is significant - Since he testifies that this is what [the members of] his father's house would do, it is the halakhah.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:7:2.english: Is it not to light - They would wrap [it] so that the wick would burn together with the nut.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:7:3.hebrew: לא להקפות - לא היו מדליקין האגוז, אלא סומך עליה הפתילה להציפה שלא תטבע בשמן. "ויצף הברזל" מתרגמינן: "וקפא פרזלא" (מלכים ב ו׳:ו׳):
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:7:3.english: No, to float [it] - They would not light the nut [itself], but rather one would support the wick upon it to make it float, so that it would not sink into the oil. [As] we translate "and the iron floated" (II Kings 6:6) [in the Targum as] "ukfa parzela."

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:8:1.english: Molten fat - Fondre in Old French [meaning melted].

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:8:2.hebrew: הני מימשכי בעינייהו - אחר הפתילה, ובלא תערובות שמן נמי חזו, אלא דגזור רבנן מהותך אטו אינו מהותך. הלכך, בעינייהו גופה גזירה, ואנן ניקום וניגזור ע"י תערובת אטו בעינייהו:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:8:2.english: These are drawn in their pure state - [They are drawn] after the wick, and even without a mixture of oil they are also fit [for lighting]; but the Sages decreed [prohibiting] molten [fat] on account of unmolten [fat]. Therefore, [prohibiting them] in their pure state is itself a decree, and shall we arise and decree [a prohibition against using them] by means of a mixture on account of [their use] in their pure state?

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:9:1.hebrew: והוא אמר לה - מפרש מאי תלמודא, והיכי משמע מהאי קרא:
Rashi on Shabbat 21a:9:1.english: And he stated it - He explains what the scriptural derivation is, and how it is implied by this verse.

Rashi on Shabbat 21a:9:2.english: And not that it ascends, etc. - And not that it should require adjustment and tilting.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:10:1.hebrew: שמחת בית השואבה שאני - תימה: היכי שרי להדליק? והא לאו צורך קרבן הוא, ואמר בפ"ב דקידושין (דף נד. ושם): "בגדי כהונה שבלו מועלין בהן"! ודוחק לומר: לב ב"ד מתנה עליהן — דמה צורך יש להן להתנות בשביל זה? ונראה לר"י, דהואיל ולכבוד הקרבן היו עושין — דכתיב: "ושאבתם מים בששון" (ישעיהו י״ב:ג׳) — צורך קרבן חשוב ליה. והא דאמר (סוכה פ"ה דף נג.): "בוררת אשה חטין לאור בית השואבה" — לא שהיתה בוררת, אלא שהיתה יכולה לברור. ומיהו, בירושלמי דייק מהכא דקול ומראה וריח אין בהן משום מעילה. וקשה לר"י: מאי פריך ממכנסי הכהנים? הלא היה בהן פשתן, דכתיב: "תכלת וארגמן ותולעת שני ושש משזר" (שמות כ״ח:ח׳), וטוב לפתילה — דהוי ככרך דבר שמדליקין בו ע"ג דבר שאין מדליקין בו; ובשבת הוא דאסור, שמא ידליק בעיניה, אבל במקדש לא שייכא הך גזירה! ונראה לר"י, דכיון שאין מן הפשתן אלא רביע, בטל בשאר מינים, והוי כאילו אין בו פשתן כלל:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:10:1.english: The Celebration of the House of Water Drawing is different - [This is] astonishing: How was it permitted to kindle [with them]? For behold, it is not a sacrificial requirement, and [the Gemara] says in the second chapter of Kiddushin (54a and there): "Worn-out priestly garments are subject to [the laws of] misappropriation [me'ilah]"! And it is forced to say that the intention of the court stipulates regarding them [that they lose their sanctity when worn out] — for what need do they have to make a stipulation for the sake of this? And it appears to the Ri that since they were doing [this] for the honor of the sacrifice — as it is written: "And you shall draw water with joy" (Isaiah 12:3) — it is considered a sacrificial requirement. And that which [the Gemara] says (Sukkah, chapter 5, 53a): "A woman would sift wheat by the light of the [Celebration of the] House of Water Drawing" — [this does] not [mean] that she would actually sift [wheat], but rather that she was able to sift. However, in the Yerushalmi [Sukkah 5:3], it deduces from here that sound, sight, and scent are not subject to [the prohibition of] me'ilah. And the Ri raises a difficulty: Why does [the Gemara] raise an objection from [the mishna regarding] the priests' trousers [and sashes]? Behold, was there not linen in them, as it is written: "sky-blue wool, and purple wool, and scarlet wool, and fine twisted linen" (Exodus 28:8) — and [linen] is good for a wick? For this is like wrapping a material with which one may kindle around a material with which one may not kindle; and it is only on Shabbat that this is prohibited, lest one kindle with it alone, but in the Temple this decree does not apply! And it appears to the Ri that since the linen was only one-quarter [of the mixture], it is nullified by the other materials, and it is as though there were no linen in it at all.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:12:1.hebrew: ומותר להשתמש לאורה - וא"ת: מנא ליה לרבא דסבר רב הונא דמותר להשתמש לאורה? דילמא הא דאמר "אין מדליקין בשבת", משום דסבר: כבתה זקוק לה, ואין יכול להדליק בשבת? וי"ל, דא"כ לא הוה צריך ליה למימר "בין בחול בין בשבת", כיון דחד טעמא הוא, אלא ה"ל למימר "אין מדליקין" סתם. מדקאמר "בין בחול בין בשבת", ש"מ שעוד יש טעם אחר בשבת שלא להדליק לבד מטעם חול, והיינו שמא יטה; וא"כ, סבר דמותר להשתמש לאורה. ומיהו רב דקאמר "מדליקין בין בחול בין בשבת", לא היה מצי למימר "מדליק" סתם, דה"א: דוקא בחול, אבל בשבת אין מדליקין שמא יטה — דבסתמא לא הייתי אומר ששום אדם יחמיר לאסור להשתמש לאורה. וכן הלכתא: דנר חנוכה אסור להשתמש לאורה כרב וכר' יוחנן, ואביי נמי קיבלה, ורב יוסף נמי משמע לקמן דס"ל הכי; וכבתה אין זקוק לה — דכולהו סבירא להו הכי, ורב הונא יחיד הוא, ולית הלכתא כוותיה:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:12:1.english: "And it is permitted to use its light" - And if you say: From where did Rava know that Rav Huna holds that it is permitted to use its light? Perhaps that which he said, "one may not light [with them] on Shabbat," is because he holds [that if] it went out, one is bound to attend to it, and one cannot light on Shabbat? And one can say: For if so, it would not have been necessary for him to say "both during the week and on Shabbat," since it is a single reason; rather, he should have simply said "one may not light." From [the fact] that he said "both during the week and on Shabbat," conclude from this that there is also another reason on Shabbat not to light, aside from the weekday reason, and that is: lest he tilt [the lamp]. And if so, he holds that it is permitted to use its light. However, Rav, who said: "one may light [with them] both during the week and on Shabbat," could not have simply said "one may light"; for [otherwise] I would have said: [This applies] specifically during the week, but on Shabbat one may not light, lest he tilt [the lamp] — for ordinarily, I would not have said that anyone would be stringent to forbid using its light. And such is the halakhah: that [with] the Hanukkah lamp, it is forbidden to use its light, in accordance with Rav and Rabbi Yoḥanan; and Abaye also accepted it; and Rav Yosef also, it is implied later, holds this way. And [regarding] "if it went out, one is not bound to attend to it" — for all of them hold this way, and Rav Huna is a solitary opinion, and the halakhah does not follow him.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:1:1.hebrew: למאי נ"מ למקח וממכר - פשיטא ליה להש"ס שהיו מכירין השעוה והעטרן, כדאמרינן: שעוה — קירותא. לכך קאמר: למאי נ"מ? למקח וממכר — שאם נדר לתת לחבירו שעוה, יתן לו פסולתא דדובשא, ואין יכול לכופו לתקן לו; וכן עיטרן. אבל לעיל, דקאמר: מאי לכש? שוכא דארזא — לא קאמר: למאי נ"מ, לפי שלא היו מכירין בשם לכש, ומפרש שהוא שוכא דארזא:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:1:1.english: "What is the practical difference? For buying and selling" - It was obvious to the Gemara that they were familiar with wax and tar, as we say [above, 20b]: "Wax is kiruta." Therefore, [the Gemara] asks: "What is the practical difference? For buying and selling" — that if one pledged to give his fellow wax, he may give him the residue of honey, and [the recipient] cannot compel him to refine it for him; and so too with tar. However, above, where [the Gemara] says: "What is lekhesh? A cedar branch," it does not ask: "What is the practical difference?", because they were not familiar with the name lekhesh, and [the Gemara] explains that it is a cedar branch.

Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:4:1.hebrew: מפני שאין נמשכין כו' - שמעתי ממהר"א זצ"ל ששמע: באם שיש רק נר א' כשר בבית, ע"י זה יזכור ולא יטה שאר נרות שבחדר ושבמרתף. ור"ש מקוצי אומר: דבר שיכול לעשות בלא נר, כגון להוציא יין מן החבית — מותר להשתמש לאור כל נר. [תוספות ישנים]:
Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:4:1.english: "Because they are not drawn, etc." - I heard from Mahara, of blessed memory, who heard: If there is even just one valid lamp in the house, through this [lamp] he will remember and will not tilt the other lamps that are in the room and in the cellar. And Rabbi Shimshon of Coucy says: [For] a task that one can do without a lamp, such as taking wine out of a barrel, it is permitted to use the light of any lamp. [Tosafot Yeshanim]

Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:8:1.hebrew: חלב מהותך וקרבי דגים שנימוחו נותן לתוכן שמן כו' - קרבי דגים לאו היינו שמן דגים, דשמן דגים שרי ליה מתני' בעיניה (לקמן שבת דף כד:):
Tosafot on Shabbat 21a:8:1.english: "Molten fat and fish innards that dissolved, one places oil into them, etc." - Fish innards are not [the same as] fish oil, for the Mishnah permits fish oil on its own (below, Shabbat 24b).
